Carries limit, argument's name, "max_stream", limit_value. zupdf_unsupported_input input uses something zupdf support, WebP image AES-256 writing. zupdf_write_error pdfio refused write, closed writer used. zupdf_font_error font file read. zupdf_io_error file, temporary file connection failed. zupdf_encoding_error Extracted text valid UTF-8 mapping. text: Opens 'PDF' files reads metadata, pages, objects, streams, fonts, images text reading order; copies pages files split, merge, rotate reorder , sets metadata, permissions encryption; writes new 'PDF' files R text, paths images. Uses bundled copy 'pdfio' library (https://github.com/michaelrsweet/pdfio), system library beyond 'zlib' required. Untrusted input bounded limits size, object count, stream size nesting depth. Pages never rendered images.

title: zupdf 0.0.0.9000
text: Development version, built stage stage; see roadmap. pdftools’s qpdf’s non-rendering functions names arguments: pdf_info(), pdf_text(), pdf_fonts(), pdf_pagesize(), pdf_toc(), pdf_attachments(), pdf_data(), pdf_length(), pdf_split(), pdf_subset(), pdf_combine() pdf_rotate_pages(), library(zupdf) can stand either package rendering needed. pdf_copy_pages() copies pages files, rotation; pdf_set_meta() sets document information; pdf_set_encryption() encrypts AES-128 RC4-128 sets permissions. writer: pdf_new() starts file, pdf_page_new() pdf_page_end() add pages, pdf_draw_text(), pdf_draw() pdf_draw_image() draw text, paths images, pdf_font() pdf_image_new() make fonts (base-14 embedded TrueType/OpenType) images (PNG, JPEG R images), pdf_save() returns writes bytes. deterministic = TRUE makes output reproducible. pdf_paper() gives paper sizes. pdf_page_text() extracts page’s text reading order stream order, ToUnicode maps, font encodings Form XObjects, U+FFFD count characters font maps. pdf_page_tokens() lists content stream’s tokens. pdf_font_table() lists fonts; pdf_page_images() page’s images; pdf_image() reads image’s samples, nativeRaster 8-bit RGB grey. pdf_objects() lists every object; pdf_object() reads one object’s value R values, marker classes names (pdf_name), references (pdf_ref) byte strings (pdf_binary); pdf_stream() reads stream, decoded (FlateDecode) stored, bounded max_stream. pdf_open() opens PDF path, raw vector connection, optional password (string, function called file needs one), limits input size, object count page count. pdf_close() closes . pdf_meta() reads version, page count, information dictionary, identifier, encryption permissions; pdf_pages() page boxes, rotation content-stream count, inherited attributes. zupdf_info() reports bundled pdfio (1.6.5, ttf library), local patches, zlib linked , features build lacks default limits.
